```{r, message=FALSE}

library(readxl)
library(stringr)
library(data.table)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
homedir <- "/lustre/scratch126/casm/team154pc/nb15/liver/"
```

```{r}

exome_calls <- fread("data/calls/exome_calls.csv",sep=",") %>%
  filter(!str_detect(sampleID, "PD63757|PD64544")) %>%
  select(mut_id,Chrom,Pos,Ref,Alt,sampleID,Mut_Frags,mutID_sampleID,coverage,vaf,Project,Type) 

samples <- unique(exome_calls$sampleID)
donors <- unique(substr(samples,1,7))

donor_info <- read.table(paste0(homedir,"/A1AD_manuscript/A1AD_patient_info_2019-10-30.csv"), sep = ",", stringsAsFactors = F, header = T) |>
  dplyr::rename(internal_id=Donor,
         age=Age)

lcm_database <-  fread(paste0(homedir,"A1AD_manuscript/2792_lcm_cut_metadata.tsv"), sep="\t", header=T, data.table=F) |>
  mutate(Project=2792) |>
  bind_rows(fread(paste0(homedir,"A1AD_manuscript/2814_lcm_cut_metadata.tsv"), sep="\t", header=T, data.table=F) %>% mutate(Project=2814)) |>
  bind_rows(fread(paste0(homedir,"A1AD_manuscript/3131_lcm_cut_metadata.tsv"), sep="\t", header=T, data.table=F) %>% mutate(Project=3131)) |>
  mutate(Feature="parenchyma") |>
  dplyr::rename(sampleID=PD.ID) |>
  dplyr::select(Project,sampleID,Feature,MEAN_COVERAGE,MEAN_TARGET_COVERAGE,MEAN_BAIT_COVERAGE) |>
  distinct()

```

```{r}
burden <- as.data.frame(array(data = NA, dim = c(length(samples),9)))
colnames(burden) <-c("internal_id","paper_donor","pd_donor","donor_age","sub_count","sub_burden","indel_count","indel_burden","median_vaf")

burden$internal_id <- samples

for(i in 1:nrow(burden)){
  burden$paper_donor[i] <- donor_info$paper_id[which(substr(burden$internal_id[i],1,7) == donor_info$internal_id)]
  burden$pd_donor[i] <- substr(burden$internal_id[i],1,7)
  burden$donor_age[i] <- as.numeric(paste0(donor_info$age[which(substr(burden$internal_id[i],1,7) == donor_info$internal_id)]))
  burden$sub_count[i] <- length(which(exome_calls$sampleID == burden$internal_id[i] & exome_calls$Type=="Sub"))
  #burden$sub_burden[i] <- (burden$sub_count[i] / non_n_genome_size) * 1000000
  burden$indel_count[i] <- length(which(exome_calls$sampleID == burden$internal_id[i] & exome_calls$Type!="Sub"))
  #burden$indel_burden[i] <- (burden$indel_count[i] / non_n_genome_size) * 1000000
  burden$median_vaf[i] <- median(unlist(exome_calls[exome_calls$sampleID == burden$internal_id[i], "vaf"]))
  burden$disease[i] <- donor_info$Disease[which(burden$pd_donor[i] == donor_info$internal_id)]
}

burden$disease <- "Haemochromatosis"
burden$disease[burden$pd_donor %in% c("PD51606","PD60232", "PD60233", "PD60802", "PD60803")] <- "A1AD"

head(burden)

burden_liver <- burden %>%
  mutate(donor_label = paste0(pd_donor, " (", donor_age, " years)")) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(disease,donor_age, pd_donor)


burden_liver$donor_label <- factor(burden_liver$donor_label, 
                                               levels = unique(burden_liver$donor_label))

subs <- ggplot(burden_liver, aes(x = donor_label, y = sub_count, fill=disease)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = median_vaf), width = 0.2, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) + # Adds jittered points colored by median_vaf
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = NULL,
       y = "SNVs per exome",
       x = NULL,
       color = "Median VAF",
       fill="Disease") +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "grey", high = "black") +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#A360A7", "#79C262"))

indels <- ggplot(burden_liver, aes(x = donor_label, y = indel_count, fill=disease)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = median_vaf), width = 0.2, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) + # Adds jittered points colored by median_vaf
theme_classic() +
  labs(title = NULL,
       y = "Indels per exome",
       x = NULL,
       color = "Median VAF",
       fill="Disease") +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "grey", high = "black") +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust=0.5),
        legend.position = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#A360A7", "#79C262")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 10))


combined_plot <- subs / indels +
  plot_layout(heights = c(5, 3))

print(combined_plot)

ggsave(plot = combined_plot, filename = "outputs/Brunner_burden_fig_reproduced_exomes.pdf", width = 8, height = 6, useDingbats = F)

```
